cta.joinBetaSub: Pick your phone — we'll send the invite.
cta.thanks: Thanks! Your invite lands within a day.
cta.creatorIntroBody: Regular shoppers don't need an account — Souply works anonymously. A creator account is only for people who want to share their templates publicly.
cta.creatorIntroBullet1: You post your grocery hauls on social media
cta.creatorIntroBullet2: You write recipes and want followers to grab the ingredients in one tap
cta.creatorIntroBullet3: You want your @handle on every basket created from your template
cta.creatorBenefit1: No more spreadsheet lists — your weekly plan becomes a basket in one tap.
cta.creatorBenefit2: Your specific brands found in seconds; clients see where to buy them cheapest.
cta.creatorBenefit3: A QR code under your recipe becomes a basket on the reader's phone.
cta.creatorBenefit4: A follower taps the link under your video and finds the products at their preferred store.
